title: Prometheus or Datadog: Self-Hosted Metrics vs a Managed Observability Platform
excerpt: Prometheus is the open-source standard for metrics in cloud-native environments; Datadog is a fully managed monitoring service. The trade-off is control and cost versus convenience.
verdict: Prometheus is the better choice when you want full control of your data and have engineers who can run and scale it. Datadog is faster to adopt for teams that want a ready-made service with many integrations and no monitoring infrastructure to manage, at a usage-based price.
